caption: The drawing depicts a single glass bottle centered on a plain, off-white background. The bottle is rendered in shades of green and is transparent, allowing the viewer to observe the subtle variations in color to indicate glass texture and highlights. It has a wide, conical base that narrows sharply before rounding out into a bulbous midsection and then tapering again into a short, narrow neck with a slightly flared lip. The overall composition is minimal, with nothing else in the scene except for the rectangular border of the drawing and a lightly stamped or printed name, "JESSICA PRICE," in the lower left corner inside the border.
title: Bottle
